_doc: Differences HiveWE is expected to make. See README.md. 'file' is a glob on the relative path or basename (case-insensitive); 'path' is a regex on the diff path; 'when' names a predicate in fdiff.py. Allowed diffs are still listed in the JSON under allowed_sample/allowed_by_rule.

rules.reason: Units::load replaces every unit z with the terrain height.
Doodads without the fixed-Z flag (0x04) get z re-derived from terrain on save.
A subversion 9 file is promoted to 11; the new fields must hold their defaults (-1, 0, 0, 0).
